dedupe_keys.name: barranquilla healthcare electrical and electronic waste management survey

description: This workbook records how sixty healthcare institutions in Barranquilla, Colombia handle waste electrical and electronic equipment. Fabio Fuentes and collaborators surveyed hospitals, clinics, dental centres and ophthalmological centres using fifteen principal questions about equipment waste, staff knowledge, temporary collection and final disposal. Mendeley version 2 lists one Excel workbook, available free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the participating institutions within the city; exact survey dates were not established from the reviewed metadata. The study is exploratory, and reported practices do not provide a complete citywide inventory of equipment mass or disposal flows. These limitations matter when estimating future waste volumes. Modellers could use the survey to define institutional behaviour and collection arrangements in healthcare equipment-lifecycle simulations. data-latvia-healthcare-waste-social-lca provides related healthcare-waste evidence from another setting. No workbook cells, institution-level responses or disposal records were downloaded, and no agreement between stated and observed practices was tested.
